---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused product or engineering improvement
title: "feature: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What owner need or engineering limitation should this solve?

## Proposed outcome

What should be observably true when complete?

## Scope

What belongs in the first reviewable increment?

## Non-goals

What should remain unchanged?

## Trust and local-first impact

Does this affect data leaving the machine, authorization, external side effects, provenance, migrations, or backwards compatibility?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable behavior
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Documentation updated
